title: Household Parking and Storage Step, Preferred Employer Program
content:
**Resident Services guidance — preferred employer program on the Apartment Home Lease.**

The preferred employer rate is raised by a household bundle step: a household holding an active Parking License and an active Storage Rental raises it by 0.005, a household holding an active Parking License and no active Storage Rental raises it by 0.0025, and any other household leaves it unchanged.

**What is read.** The customer's Parking License records and Storage Rental records, and whether any of them is in active status on the handling date. A license or rental in any other status is not an active holding.

**Effect.** The step raises the preferred employer rate itself; the raised rate is applied to the period's base rent line.

## Combinations

| Active Parking License held | Active Storage Rental held | Household bundle step |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 0.005 (0.5%) |
| Yes | No | 0.0025 (0.25%) |
| No | Yes | nothing |
| No | No | nothing |

**Point of judgement.** An active Storage Rental on its own, with no active Parking License, adds nothing: the step turns first on the parking license.

*Hypothetical:* a household with an active covered carport license and an active storage closet, on a floor plan rate of 0.05, carries a rate of 0.055 from this step; the same household after its storage rental ends carries 0.0525.
